title: ice packs
text: ice packs. These are made with beautiful, quality feeling canvas or canvas like material.  They are the perfect size for a lunch box, an owie that needs a little cold care or mini lunch bag/basket/bento.  I really like them. Not sure about longevity as I just got them - but they just look and feel like high quality.  Time will tell, so I always add that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!

product_metadata.title: kinsho Ice Pack for Kids Lunch Box, Bag and Bento Boxes, 4 Pack Set, Reusable and Refreezable Soft Slim Pouches for Travel, School, Work or Camping, Long Lasting Cold, Flexible | Aqua Orange…
features: PREMIUM LUNCH BOX ICE PACKS– Ideal for kid’s lunches, office snacks, or keeping food and drinks colder when you’re traveling or on the go. These reusable ice packs are designed with a flexible exterior and long-lasting gel inside. LARGE + SLIM rectangular shape is made to provide superior cooling coverage. Size 4.3" x 7.5" x 0.4 / 10.9 x 19 x 1 cm.

MALLEABLE POUCH DESIGN– Unlike ice blocks or packs that are inflexible ours can bend and shape to your lunch box storage pockets when un-frozen (will freeze solid), which makes them easier to use for a variety of different bento and lunchbox styles.

SOFT TOUCH FABRIC EXTERIOR – Deluxe nylon is filled with ECO-FRIENDLY freezing cellulose-based gel to help minimize moisture inside. This keeps your coolers, lunch totes and containers dryer and helps prevent soggy breads or contents. PVC, BPA, Lead and Phthalate-free.

REUSEABLE AND REFREEZABLE– A smart choice for busy parents or adults looking to save money and time our lunch box ice packs are SUPER COOL to last up to 4 hours per use and can be frozen again simply by putting it back in the freezer.

IDEAL LUNCH BAG PAIRING – These multipurpose ice packs pair perfectly with kinsho bento boxes and lunch bags and slip in seamlessly without taking up much-needed space making them ideal for school or work use. DITCH THE PLASTIC in other ice pack containers and upgrade your lunchbox!
